The dominant side in the Malaysia Super League, Johor Darul Ta’zim, come up against Thai outfit Port FC at the Sultan Ibrahim Stadium in Gelang Patah.

Kick-off date/time: [...] How to watch on TV:UK – Not televised / USA – Paramount+

How to watch online:UK – Cannot be streamed / USA – Paramount+

Johor Darul Ta’zim vs Port prediction

Johor Darul Ta’zim come into this one on the back of a 2-0 defeat of Brunei DPMM in the first-leg of their Malaysia FA Cup semi-final tie. In the AFC Champions League, the Malaysians have collected four points from their opening two matches. [...] Port FC come into this one on the back of a tough start to their AFC Champions League Elite league stage with a couple of defeats thus far, although their 4-1 hammering of Rayong at the weekend leaves them at the top-of-the-table in the Thai Premier League.

Port will fancy themselves to be better in this one against weaker opposition but Johor Darul Ta’zim do have to remain favourites with their home advantage.
